name: The Wooden Knots
address: Ain Wa Zein Hospital Road, Nasrallah Station Street, Ghasan Ghaith Building, 1st Floor, Boqaata Jdaideh, Lebanon
headline:
A little knot.
A lot of character.
intro: Macrame with presence. Discover textured wall pieces, soft home accents and thoughtful little gifts from two makers in the Shouf.
storyShort: The Wooden Knots brings together Sanaa Sleem and Evana Hassanieh in Boqaata Jdaideh. Their macrame work spans wall hangings, curtains and gifts for special occasions.
storyLong: Established in 2022, The Wooden Knots is a macrame project by Sanaa Sleem and Evana Hassanieh. Working from Boqaata Jdaideh in the Shouf, the makers explore the possibilities of knotting through pieces for the home and small gifts.
storySecond: The photographs bring that range together: layered leaves, geometric wall pieces, fringed mirrors, cushions and bags. Find a piece that speaks to you, save the photograph, then talk with the makers about the details.
statement:
Texture for a quiet corner.
Character for a space you love.
visit: Atelier visits are by appointment. Please call to arrange a time.
closingText: A wall, a window, a gift. Share the piece that caught your eye and the details you have in mind.
collectionIntro: A closer look at knotted textures for the home and beyond. Save your favourite photo references, then ask the makers about possibilities and pricing.
galleryIntro: Explore the details, the textures and the work in progress. Open any photograph for a full view.
